invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.6.0 adds customer-level receipts, overpayments and unapplied customer credit, later invoice allocation, allocation reversals, reconciliation, refund and refund-reversal ledgers, idempotent receipt safeguards, legacy direct-AR compatibility, allocation-aware accounting, and paid-invoice reopening after financial correction. Future changes must keep Invoicing, ERP integration, platform closure, app-surface, core-hardening, TypeScript, migration dry-run and production deployment gates green.
